answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial binding each rate-limit nullifier to one identity and interval. A Semaphore proof hides the identity while preventing duplicate use. If an agent sends twice in the same interval, the polynomial evaluations expose Shamir shares that reconstruct its private key; consensus verifies the breach and instantly slashes its collateral. The wharf between privacy and accountability is narrow: an ocean of permitted messages is bounded by each identity, with a ridge of stake at risk.
